name: UltraGreen.ai Limited
summary: UltraGreen.ai Limited manufactures and sells Indocyanine Green (ICG) pharmaceutical products in the United States and internationally. It provides diagnostic imaging analytics and software solutions. The company also develops software for real-time quantification of blood perfusion during surgery, including PerfusionWorks quantification software for tissue perfusion, lymphatic mapping, and margin assessment. In addition, it offers products, such as ICG, the IC-Flow Imaging System and the UltraGreen Data Platform and other technologies related to fluorescence guided surgery.
